description: Mountfield MTF66M Compact Rear-Collect & Side-Discharge Ride-On Mower with Gear Drive
marketingText: This ride-on mower will collect or mulch making it a two-in-one machine. With a cutting-width of a mere 66cm, this ultra-compact ride-on mower from famous British brand, Mountfield, is suitable for obstacle-packed lawns, which are that little bit too big to cover efficiently with a walk-behind machine. The Mountfield MTF66 MQ Ride-On Mower is a recycling mower, which reduces grass clippings to a fine, highly compostable mulch that's spread evenly over the lawn surface, where it will rapidly rot-down and vanish. This process will see the turf benefit from the natural nutrients and moisture released by the decomposition process. Thanks to its five-speed gearbox (4+1), five-stage cutting-height and additional side-discharge function, the Mountfield MTF66 MQ Compact Lawn Rider can be set-up to achieve excellent results, no matter what the weather conditions or grass length. It features an under-seat contact breaker, which optimises safety by ensuring the engine won't run if you're not at the controls, and it's driven by a beefy, 4.8hp (224cc), Stiga ST 250 ES electric-start engine, which boasts an OHV-type layout for reduced noise, wear, vibration and fuel consumption. Unusually for a mulching/side-discharge machine, the versatile Mountfield MTF66 MQ is also collection capable, with the large, 150-litre-capacity grassbag included in the package. You'll also get a mow-in-reverse capability, which increases productivity by allowing you - providing you're totally sure it's safe - to backup with the blade engaged. Side chute, mulch plug and battery charger included worth over £200. PLEASE NOTE: This machine is NOT compatible with light towing. If you are looking for a compact mower with this facility, why not take a look at our Spectrum DC24! This model is covered by a two-year manufacturer's warranty, and is suitable for use across lawns up to around 2000m2.
